anomalies.observed: On the root sheet, U2 has global labels SWDIO on PA13, SWCLK on PA14 and SWO on PB3. The J1 Tag-Connect symbol has pins named SWDIO, SWCLK and SWO, but those pins are not connected by wires or by matching global labels to the MCU SWD nets; only J1 GND and VCC have power symbols attached.
anomalies.expected: The specification describes J1 as the SWD/JTAG programming header and says its pins are VCC, GND, ~{RESET}, SWCLK, SWDIO, SWO, so the connector pins must share the corresponding MCU SWD nets.

evidence.quote: Root sheet: U2 labels 'SWDIO', 'SWCLK', 'SWO'; J1 pins 'SWDIO', 'SWCLK', 'SWO' are not wired or labelled to those nets.
Its pins are VCC, GND, ~{RESET}, SWCLK, SWDIO, SWO — a standard ARM debug/programming interface

anomalies.impact: A Tag-Connect programmer would not be connected to the MCU SWD signals, making programming/debugging through J1 fail or be unreliable.

anomalies.observed: The J1 reset pin appears to carry a global label 'MBST' on the root sheet, while the MCU reset net is labelled 'NRST' at U2 pin 7 and pulled up by R10. There is no NRST/RESET label or wire joining the J1 reset pin to the MCU reset net.
anomalies.expected: The specification states that NRST is also wired to J1 pin 3 (~{RESET}); the connector reset pin should be on the same NRST net as the MCU reset pin.

evidence.quote: Root sheet: MCU label 'NRST' at U2 pin 7 with R10 to VCC; J1 reset pin label 'MBST'.
R10 (10 kΩ) ties NRST to VCC ... NRST is also wired to J1 pin 3 (~{RESET})

anomalies.impact: The programmer cannot assert or observe MCU reset through J1; debug entry and reset control may fail even if the SWD data lines were connected.

anomalies.observed: A root-sheet tile shows an additional powered IC U5, part 74LVG1XOR, with global labels TRXJ_XOR_A and TRXJ_XOR_B and an XOR output label.
anomalies.expected: The intended Portal design described in the specification contains U2, U3, U4, A2, A1 and J1 only; there is no such logic gate or TRXJ interface in the component table or architecture.

evidence.quote: Component table lists U2, U3, U4, A2, A1, J1; no U5 or 74LVG1XOR is present.

anomalies.impact: An unneeded powered XOR gate is present. As drawn its signal labels are not connected to the rest of the board, but it is a clear deviation from the intended component set and could indicate tampering or an assembly/sourcing mistake.

parsed.summary: The schematic contains functional deviations: the Tag-Connect SWD header is not connected to the MCU SWD/reset labels, and an unlisted XOR gate U5 appears on the root sheet.
